title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
snippet: Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%.

title: BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation
snippet: Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.
